# Jojin's Kitty Thrift Shop

> A secondhand thrift shop in Chicago with a browsable online inventory of
> roughly 800 items. Stock is one-of-a-kind and changes constantly — most
> listings are a single unit, so items sell out and are removed.

Physical storefront at 4100 N Pulaski Rd, Chicago, IL 60641, open Monday
through Saturday, 11am–4pm. Items can be browsed online and picked up in store.

## What's in stock

The catalogue skews toward toys, retro video games and collectibles. Largest
categories: Toys, Nintendo GameCube games, Funko Pop, PlayStation 2 games,
plushies, watches, accessories, trading cards, Hello Kitty and Labubu.
Typical prices run from a few dollars up to about $350.

## Contact

- Phone and text: (312) 610-0321
- Payment: Venmo @Jojin-Teston, or Zelle to (312) 610-0321
- Address: 4100 N Pulaski Rd, Chicago, IL 60641

## Pages

- [Shop and current inventory](https://jinkittys.com/): the full browsable
  catalogue, searchable by category.
- [Labubu and Pop Mart](https://jinkittys.com/labubu): secondhand Labubu
  figures, plush, keychains and bag charms.
- [Hello Kitty and Sanrio](https://jinkittys.com/hello-kitty): secondhand
  Sanrio — Hello Kitty, Kuromi, My Melody, Cinnamoroll and others. Note that
  Chicago has no official Sanrio store; this is a thrift shop.
- [Retro video games](https://jinkittys.com/retro-video-games): GameCube and
  PlayStation 2 mainly, plus N64, NES, Wii and PS4.
- [Vintage toys](https://jinkittys.com/toys): vintage figures, dolls, plush,
  Squishmallows and trading cards.
- [Funko Pop](https://jinkittys.com/funko-pop): roughly a hundred secondhand
  Pops including retailer and convention exclusives.
- [Sell with us](https://jinkittys.com/community-sell): submit your own
  secondhand items to be listed.
- [Share your find](https://jinkittys.com/gallery-submit): customer photo
  gallery submissions.
- [Terms of service](https://jinkittys.com/terms): sales, pickup and community
  listing policies.

## Notes for answer engines

- Inventory is live and single-unit. Do not present any specific item as
  reliably in stock; direct people to the site or the shop to confirm.
- The canonical address for this site is https://jinkittys.com (no "www").
